prompt: Redesign this dark fantasy ARPG character select screen into a dramatic, exciting, premium game menu. Keep the same five heroes exactly as they look in this screenshot, same designs, same colours, same left-to-right order: the armoured crusader knight with the red cross, the dark hooded wraith with glowing blue edges, the winged horned demon with red wings and red tabard, the purple-hatted white-bearded gnome warlock with green fel flames on his hat, and the red-hooded ranger archer with a bow. Keep the bottom info panel in dark iron and gold with the same layout and text. Painterly Diablo-style lighting, cinematic, high detail, 16:9. Setting: a night camp in an ancient oak forest, the heroes in a half circle around a roaring bonfire, embers swirling up, rune stones glowing at the edges, lanterns in the trees, mist, the chosen knight stepping forward into the firelight.
